images.prompt: Actual in-game screenshot of a stylish top-down 2D action arena game, 16:9 landscape, full-bleed, no device frame, no poster framing, no title text. Camera straight overhead on a dark slate-blue square arena floor with a faint tile grid and a thin glowing cyan border, subtle vignette, moody neon-noir lighting. Center: the player character, a small cloaked swordsman seen from above, rendered in pale icy white-cyan with a soft glow, mid-dash, leaving a short motion-blurred cyan afterimage trail and a bright crescent sword-slash arc in front of him. Around the arena: four translucent crimson-red ghost copies of the SAME swordsman (identical silhouette, same cloak, same sword), each slightly see-through with a red glow and a short red afterimage trail, each mid-motion in a different place; one of them is also swinging a red crescent slash. Thin faint red dotted lines extend ahead of each ghost showing where it will move next. Small dashed red circles mark spots on the floor. A burst of red and pink spark particles where a ghost was just cut apart near the player. Minimal clean HUD in Korean: top-left small grey label "버틴 시간" above large white monospace numbers "00:41.36"; top-center a thin circular countdown ring with "8.6" inside and below it small pink text "다음 유령 · 00:40~00:50의 나"; top-right small grey label "지운 나 · 남은 나" above "3 · 4" with the 4 in red. Above each red ghost a tiny pink label like "00:10의 나", "00:20의 나", "00:30의 나". Crisp vector-like readability, high contrast, tense and kinetic mood.
